a: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
p: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa hab lī mulkan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī, innaka anta-l-Wahhāb.
m: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
